blocks.title: Dashboard changes
blocks.summary: 5 related files share the "dashboard" change signal.

inspectionQuestions.observation: The implementation and a nearby companion test both changed in this diff.
inspectionQuestions.question: Which changed test demonstrates the new behavior, including its failure or boundary case?

explanations.title: Organization dashboard pages are now routable
explanations.summary: Known organization-level sections now render a dashboard page, while invalid organization names, unknown sections, and malformed routes return a 404.

explanations.title: Repository settings and pull-request routes are added
explanations.summary: Repository-specific settings and pull-request detail pages are supported under the repository path; pull-request numbers must be positive integers.

explanations.title: Pull-request pages display the review report
explanations.summary: A repository pull-request detail page now embeds its review report using the organization, repository, and pull-request number in the report URL.

evidence.label: Human review progress

limits: Progress is stored only in this browser and is not shared with GitHub.

evidence.label: Deterministic analysis
evidence.detail: Rules, attention signals, and inspection questions were computed from this exact comparison. Zero findings means no matches, not that the change is safe.

evidence.detail: No hosted AI finding set was attached.
limits: AI findings are proposals to inspect, not proof of correctness.
